title: Trendi Concierge - AI Receptionist, Monthly Subscription
description: Concierge is an AI receptionist for small business. It answers from your own website and business information, captures contact details and records every enquiry in a built-in CRM. It includes agreed appointment times, booking records and follow-up tasks, new-enquiry alerts to the email and phone you nominate, website chat added with one line of code, and a private portal with owner, editor and viewer roles. Setup, knowledge import from your website and channel testing are part of onboarding. There is no per-call or per-minute charge from Trendi; a phone number or SMS provider, if you use one, is billed separately. Prices are in USD. Trendi does not promise leads or sales. Monthly plan: 3-month minimum, then it renews monthly.
